welcome.title: A note from the Chief Warden
welcome.portraitAlt: Illustrated placeholder portrait of the Chief Warden
welcome.placeholder: Illustrative placeholder. Fictional name and portrait.
welcome.p1: A mess is the one place on campus where everyone meets every day. It should feel dependable: food on time, a clear menu, and a fair wait.
welcome.p2: RAM is how we are working towards that. Digital tokens replace paper, menus and timings are public, and the improvements we make are posted where you can see them.
welcome.p3: If something can be done better, tell us. We would rather hear it early.
welcome.name: Dr. Raghavendra Iyer

initiatives.title: Five initiatives, in plain terms
initiatives.lead: These are the directions the Chief Warden's office is pursuing. Progress is reported openly in the daily progress board below.

paper.title: Zero Paper Tokens
paper.desc: Meal tokens live on your phone. No printed slips to buy, lose or throw away, and no queue at the token window.

waste.title: Food Waste Reduction
waste.desc: Counting who eats helps kitchens cook closer to real demand, so less good food ends up in the bin.

grab.title: Grab & Go
grab.desc: A quicker lane for simple, ready items when you are between classes.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.desc: Menus, timings and improvements are public, and we show our figures with their limits.

wellness.title: Wellness
wellness.desc: Balanced plates, fresh vegetables and lighter options on every menu.

messSections.othersLead: These messes exist but their names and details are not yet confirmed, so they are listed plainly and without guesses.
